sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast。

sentences.en: Today I'm excited to talk about airports I hate airports are the worst my experience with airports is probably very similar to everybody else's whenever.
sentences.tc: 今天我很高興談論機場，我討厭機場是最糟糕的機場，我在機場的經歷可能與其他人的經歷非常相似。

sentences.en: I go to the airport I just pray I didn't forget one tiny detail one tiny deta tell that could make me miss my flight.
sentences.tc: 我去機場，我只是祈禱我沒有忘記任何一個微小的細節，一個微小的細節，這可能會讓我錯過航班。

sentences.en: I'm done I check one more time I always make sure to check in online I check in right away so that.

sentences.en: One thing I can say about airports is that anything goes you can see people sleeping people eating McDonald's at 8 a.m. Watching movies running stretching.
sentences.tc: 關於機場我能說的一件事是，無論發生什麼，你都可以看到人們在睡覺，人們在早上 8 點吃麥當勞，看電影跑步伸展。

sentences.en: You can see people doing anything goes at the airport where else.
sentences.tc: 你可以看到人們在機場其他地方做任何事。

sentences.en: Can you see people doing all of those things in one place nowhere only at the airport airports also give me that nervous excitement that feeling of butterflies in my stomach butterflies?

sentences.en: What are some tips you can give me to enjoy airports more I used to have long layovers I wanted to save money as much money as I possibly could?

sentences.en: I would book flights as long as 52 hours with 12h hour layovers for my trip to Thailand.

sentences.en: I had a 12h hour layover in Los Angeles I took advantage of my long layover and I visit visited Hollywood with my cousin.
sentences.tc: 我在洛杉磯停留了 12 個小時，利用漫長的停留時間，我和表弟一起參觀了好萊塢。
